backend.command: Studio: Playbooks and Plays > Save Assignments > Write a label's book type

gui.reason: Explicit confirmation in Save Assignments; requires a raw roster and an already installed same-side book. Experimental and absent from presets.

input_constraints: Only the known raw 2,715,908-byte Xbox roster layout passing strict readers; no signed-container, PS3 or season input.
The type must already exist in the save string pool. Only the selected four-byte type pointer changes, with every team assignment and existing string byte preserved.
Resolve the installed SPLB by CRC32 filename and verify its internal name and side through the built game's roster.
Source SHA-256 must still match. Output and receipt are exclusive new files; reread and independently verify them.
portme: Witness the clone's distinctive formation/play for an affected team, then save and reload and inspect again.
New string allocation and season conversion need separate layout proof.

public_distribution.rule: Distribute tooling and metadata only; users supply their own roster and built game.

runtime.scope: UNWITNESSED: serialized label/type and built resource are verified offline; loaded-book behavior and persistence require a player witness.

fields.allowed: existing saved string and installed same-side SPLB name
fields.name: book_type

selectors.notes: Every team sharing the saved label uses the changed type; team label assignments remain unchanged.

source_container.format: Raw Xbox Roster.ROS with one-based relative label type pointer
source_container.resource: root[11] label type pointer and existing UTF-16BE string pool

summary: Bind a saved label to a clone already installed in a built game, after explicit confirmation, and write a new verified raw roster plus receipt.
title: Saved label book type
